primary_track: Original engine within event-like single-core deployment; accelerator track reported separately
resources: Training hardware, available people and budget not yet specified
rules: Keep original submission code and trained model provenance
No candidate edits to referee, benchmark or acceptance criteria
Final holdout never used for training or adaptive selection
required_before_running: Declare minimum useful effect and analysis method
Freeze opening split and seed manifests
Assign a total trial budget and independent confirmation budget
promotion_protocol: Frozen candidate confirmation on fresh openings
Independent seed or run replication as relevant
important_limit: Short screens are exploratory; they do not prove small Elo gains. Final sample sizes follow pilot variance and prespecified power.

experiments.title: Freeze the target and measure experiment costs
experiments.hypothesis: A reproducible benchmark and measured costs are prerequisites for useful optimisation.
variants: Unmodified starter through the local referee
experiments.primary_metric: Reproducibility and measured seconds/cost per experiment
experiments.accept: Reference settings, hashes, clocks, openings and resource accounting are complete; repeated deterministic checks agree.
experiments.reject: Unexplained outcome changes or resource contention remain.

experiments.title: Verify an original board/search core
experiments.hypothesis: The new core preserves exact legal chess state while enabling faster search.
variants: python-chess reference for legality and state
diagnostics: Castling, en passant, promotions, check evasions
experiments.accept: No unexplained differential failures across declared suites; cold-start and memory fit deployment.
experiments.reject: Any known illegal move, inconsistent state, or deadline-unsafe path.

experiments.title: Measure the classical baseline and informative opponent ladder
experiments.hypothesis: A clean classical engine provides an informative baseline and can generate useful training games.
experiments.primary_metric: Score by opponent under specified clocks
experiments.accept: Complete-game results are reproducible and include opponents that discriminate candidate quality.
experiments.reject: Near-universal wins/losses leave no ranking signal, or operational failures dominate.

experiments.title: Compare learned evaluator costs and training targets
experiments.hypothesis: A compact original evaluator improves whole-engine strength enough to repay its inference cost.
variants: Regression versus categorical/WDL loss with other factors controlled
experiments.primary_metric: A1 versus A0 match score at equal wall time
experiments.accept: A finalist passes prespecified match confirmation and resource checks; independent training reproduces the direction.
experiments.reject: Only offline loss improves, or inference cost erases match strength.

experiments.title: Test where learned move ordering pays
experiments.hypothesis: Selected policy calls reduce wasted search more than they cost.
experiments.primary_metric: Match score under the same total move budget
experiments.accept: Independent confirmation favours a placement and shows no major tactical regression.
experiments.reject: Policy accuracy increases while same-clock score regresses.

experiments.title: Compare policy/value MCTS and Gumbel allocation
experiments.hypothesis: An original policy/value search can compete at a measured CPU or accelerator budget.
experiments.primary_metric: Score at matched stated deployment resources
experiments.accept: The branch is competitive on a declared track and its scaling justifies further investment.
experiments.reject: Apparent gains rely on unreported hardware or disappear at the relevant clock.
outputs: CPU and accelerator results kept separate

experiments.title: Compare bounded architecture optimisers
experiments.hypothesis: Adaptive search finds better validated architectures per total budget than random search.
experiments.primary_metric: Best confirmed score versus cumulative research cost
experiments.accept: Independent optimiser runs improve the cost/quality trade-off and their winners retrain successfully.
experiments.reject: Only the best lucky run improves or low-fidelity selection does not transfer.

experiments.title: Tune numeric search and clock parameters
experiments.hypothesis: Original search/time constants contain recoverable match strength.
variants: CMA-ES on a modest continuous subset if warranted
experiments.accept: Fresh confirmation supports improvement after tuning is finished.
experiments.reject: Gains exist only on tuning openings or at a different clock.

experiments.title: Compare targeted labelling with uniform additional data
experiments.hypothesis: Failure/disagreement-based data acquisition improves strength more per annotation hour.
variants: Failure-focused sample mixed with representative data
experiments.primary_metric: Confirmed strength gain per annotation plus training cost
experiments.accept: Targeted sampling improves representative full-game performance, not only its selected diagnostics.
experiments.reject: Diagnostic gains are offset by ordinary-position regressions.

experiments.title: Test population training and opponent mixtures
experiments.hypothesis: A diverse checkpoint league and adaptive schedules outperform a simple training control.
variants: PBT with compatible checkpoints if compute permits
experiments.primary_metric: Confirmed score versus total training and self-play cost
experiments.accept: The league or PBT improves generalisation and cost-adjusted strength across seeds.
experiments.reject: Added population overhead produces no confirmed benefit.

experiments.title: Learn a small controller for the next unit of computation
experiments.hypothesis: A cheap controller allocates search/verification/stop decisions better than fixed rules.
experiments.accept: The learned controller wins at equal total time and remains reliable on unseen families.
experiments.reject: It predicts uncertainty without improving decisions or spends more time than it saves.

experiments.title: Discover and test target-budget Stockfish errors
experiments.hypothesis: Reproducible, legally reachable mistakes exist at the specified reference budget.
experiments.primary_metric: Verified distinct errors per discovery cost
experiments.accept: Errors reproduce at the target budget and remain diverse after deduplication.
experiments.reject: Only malformed/synthetic histories or much smaller target budgets produce errors.

experiments.title: Induce discovered weaknesses in complete games
experiments.hypothesis: A restrained opponent-aware policy can improve full-game score by reaching target weaknesses.
variants: Opponent-aware tie-breaking within estimated safe set
More aggressive policy for explicit risk ablation
experiments.primary_metric: Full-game score against pinned Stockfish on unseen openings
experiments.accept: Independent complete-game confirmation shows a gain without unacceptable general regression.
experiments.reject: Crafted-position gains do not transfer to games or disappear with modest resource/version changes.

experiments.title: Measure LLM program evolution against simpler development
experiments.hypothesis: Coding-agent proposals discover useful algorithmic changes beyond numeric tuning.
experiments.primary_metric: Best independently validated engine per equal total development budget
experiments.accept: Replicated development runs show better final quality or lower cost; evaluator protection remains intact.
experiments.reject: The agentic process only produces more proposals or selects lucky candidates.

experiments.title: Run the frozen full-strength reference campaign
experiments.hypothesis: The selected frozen original engine has expected score above 0.5 against the pinned full-strength reference.
experiments.primary_metric: Opening-pair-aware score estimate and prespecified uncertainty test
experiments.accept: The prespecified primary test supports positive advantage; no post-selection setting changes; independent replication confirms the result.
experiments.reject: Evidence is inconclusive, the lower uncertainty bound does not exceed equality, or settings compromise the stated claim.
